meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 里敲 /caveman-stats,它会把当前会话记录的输出 token、缓存读取 token、响应次数和模式归属,原样打印在代码块里,不自行重算。在 Gemini CLI 里则会引导你用 /stats model 或 /stats session。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-stats 时触发。在 Gemini CLI 中它会改为引导你使用 /stats model 或 /stats session;其他宿主若有原生用量报告就用它,没有则回复当前会话用量不可用。

say.note: 打印当前会话的 token 用量报告
按会话汇总各自最近记录的输出量
汇总最近 7 天的记录输出量

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, /caveman-stats prints the session's recorded output and cache-read tokens, response counts and mode attribution verbatim in a code block. In Gemini CLI it points you to /stats model or /stats session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-stats. In Gemini CLI it instead points to /stats model or /stats session; other hosts use a native usage report if available, else it says session usage is unavailable.

say_en.note: Prints this session's token usage report
Aggregates the latest recorded output count per session
Aggregates latest output count per session over 7 days
